title: Wire real source-backed spatial evidence into the default runtime provider (live spatial integration)
objective: Close the review finding A / priority-1 product gap: the complete spatial engine + connector adapter (services/api/app/spatial/adapter.py compose_from_connectors, engine.py, and the three accepted connectors) exists with zero app/ callers while api/v1/rule_evaluation.py's default provider returns None, so every live evaluation fail-safes to professional review. Implement a real default spatial substrate provider that composes the existing adapters behind get_spatial_substrate_provider() with settings-gated enablement (default OFF for CI determinism; explicit env/settings flag turns the live path on), preserving every existing fail-safe: absent/conflicting/uncertain spatial evidence must still land in the documented fail-safe outcomes, never a fabricated substrate. No new spatial engine; no change to rules or thresholds; typed errors and provenance preserved. Add focused tests proving (1) provider OFF == current behavior byte-for-byte, (2) provider ON with injected connector doubles produces a real substrate through the default path, (3) connector failure/partial data still fail-safes. Keep changes modular per docs/CODE_MODULARITY_POLICY.md.
business_reason: D-032 R015 step 1 (owner 2026-09-06 continuous-build amendment): first product deliverable of the delivery plan - real source integration on the default path; prerequisite for durable analyses and the R5 pilot MVP.
inputs: services/api/app/rules/integration.py (fail-safe outcomes - read-only reference, do not modify)
outputs: services/api/app/spatial/live_provider.py (new: settings-gated default provider composing the existing adapters; explicit enable flag, default OFF)
services/api/app/api/v1/rule_evaluation.py (default provider delegates to the gated live provider)
services/api/tests/spatial/test_live_provider.py (new: OFF==current-behavior, ON-with-doubles real substrate, failure fail-safe)
acceptance_scenarios: S1 default-off parity: with the enable flag unset, get_spatial_substrate_provider() yields exactly the current None-substrate behavior and every existing rule_evaluation/spatial test passes unchanged.

S2 live path with doubles: with the flag enabled and connector doubles injected, a request through the DEFAULT provider (no dependency_overrides) produces a real spatial_intersection substrate that reaches integration.evaluate_property.

S3 fail-safe preserved: with the flag enabled and a connector raising/returning partial data, the outcome is the documented fail-safe (professional review / conditional), never a fabricated substrate, with typed error provenance.
S4 modularity: new module stays within thresholds; ruff clean; no import cycles.
